title: Nourishing Pillowy Dutch Beef Casserole
description: A hearty Dutch dish featuring tender beef, rich sherry, and sweet candy, all in a pillowy casserole, perfect for a special occasion, and friendly to those who avoid onion and garlic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the sherry wine, beef broth, flour, salt, and pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the mixed fruit candy and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked beef mixture and mashed potatoes, stirring until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and dot the top with butter.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
